* [001 — Keep re-export shims for external peer deps - they dedupe esbuild bundle imports](entries/001.md) — esbuild emits one external-module import per source statement and never cross-file merges them, minified or not; a re-export shim collapses N consumers to one import. Don't delete such shims as pure indirection. · `triggers: delete-shim, re-export-barrel, esbuild-external, bundle-imports` · `tags: arch, bundling, dom` · `type: decision`

Infinity` to setCacheData (not the raw option), matching resource()'s default; a resource that later reads the entry cache-hits with no background refetch. · `triggers: prefetch, staleTime, swr` · `tags: resource, cache` · `type: decision`

* [005 — SSR readiness by package — core/store DOM-free, css collect-ready, resource already server-safe, dom importable-but-inert, html``/babel AST is the DOM-free seam](entries/005.md) — Verified 2026-07-03. core + store have zero DOM refs. css guards every DOM write behind hasDocument() and builds its textContent mirror BEFORE the guard (varsStore.ts:166) — so the string is collect-ready server-side. resource IS server-import-safe (hasDocument at lifecycle.ts:32, hasWindow at cache.ts:23) — an earlier grep-based 'unguarded' claim was wrong, corrected by reading guard context. dom imports cleanly (no module-scope DOM access) but mountNode is hardwired to document.createElement (render.ts:86). html`` parser + babel plugin produce HellaNode ASTs with zero DOM refs — the natural seam for a string-emitting second backend. · `triggers: ssr-readiness, renderToString, hydration, ssr-audit` · `tags: arch, ssr, core, css, dom, resource` · `type: decision`
